items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Yeah and Buster and a whole bunch of musicians up there.

ctx.x: Sure he was. Well I got over there at Wickle and I got with George Carver's band, they were all readers, George could read. We did very good with that band. And while I was there, Wardell, well I'm cutting out a lot of it because I had gone up to Omeon Nebraska and had a band of my own up there in Omeon Nebraska. And I ran into this guy, Nat Tolles. Nat Tolles, he's still on there.
He is from New Orleans. Yeah and Buster and a whole bunch of musicians up there. He is from New Orleans.

And I stayed with there about three years. I played Omeon Nebraska in there. Played in the grotto. But I stayed in my long time. I stayed in the grotto. But I stayed in my long time. I stayed in the grotto. And I stayed in the grotto. And I stayed in the grotto. I was in the plantation garden. I was in South Park.
